description: You have been teaching yourself French for the past year using apps, podcasts, and a weekly language exchange with a native speaker in Paris. To immerse yourself more deeply, you want to reconfigure your Mac to match French regional conventions. Open System Settings and make these five changes: (1) add French to your preferred languages list under General > Language & Region (French should appear in the list, alongside English), (2) change the measurement system to Metric under Language & Region, (3) change the temperature unit to Celsius under Language & Region, (4) enable 24-hour time (Europeans use a 24-hour clock — change this in Language & Region's Time Format or the Clock settings), and (5) change the first day of the week to Monday under Language & Region (French calendars start on Monday, not Sunday). All five changes must persist — the verifier reads NSGlobalDomain preferences and your local GlobalPreferences plist.
